title: Siman 296
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: אָמַרמַה שֶּׁיִּהְיֶה נַעֲשֶׂה עִמִּי אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ, אֲבָל זֶה פָּעַלְתִּי אֵצֶל הַשֵּׁם
segments.en: (6.) I heard in his name that he said: "It is written in the Zohar [page 11b in the Introduction]: 'There is awe and there is awe' etc. I want to reveal and instill in my people an awe — a wondrous awe the like of which has never yet been in the world."
